summary: All 3 tests failed due to timeout waiting for the locator getByRole('link', { name: 'Category Name' }) to be clickable. Each test exceeded the 30000ms timeout without finding or interacting with the expected link element.
rootCause: The tests are timing out waiting for a link with role 'link' and name 'Category Name'. This indicates that the selector used to identify the category link does not match any element on the page, possibly due to changes in the UI or incorrect selector usage.
